summary: The public title of this exercise is Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation. Read a count followed by that many strings from standard input and compute the result named by that title, using only those values. Print the result as one integer. The sample below is a short input written for this playground so the printed line can be checked locally. It is not a copy of an example from the problem site. The input stays under one hundred elements so it finishes quickly in the browser.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count followed by that many strings.
